ch1.title: Chapter 1 · The Balance of Regents
ch1.task: Read the chronicle, then choose your council policy and issue this chapter’s orders.

beats.caption: Autumn 1598. Hideyoshi is dead, and the regents who swore to protect his young heir now watch one another.
At Edo, Ieyasu fills his granaries and repairs his roads. Every bale and bridge may matter when the promises break.
From Osaka, Ishida Mitsunari gathers lords who fear Ieyasu’s ambition.
Edo is your base. Osaka holds Hideyoshi’s heir and Ishida’s allies. Between them runs the Tōkaidō: everything you build must travel this road.

ch2.title: Chapter 2 · The Aizu Question
ch2.task: Choose your council policy, then decide how to supply the march and protect Edo.

beats.caption: Far to the north, Uesugi Kagekatsu fortifies Aizu. Ieyasu calls it defiance and prepares to march.
The army marches north toward Aizu. Every soldier on the road eats from Edo’s granaries.
Behind the marching army, Edo’s walls are thinly held.
Uesugi’s banners rise at Aizu. Your army marches north to Oyama, and Edo is left behind with a small garrison.

ch3.title: Chapter 3 · The Western Army Rises
ch3.task: Choose your council policy, then prepare the march west. Gifu is the gate into Mino.

beats.caption: Oyama, late summer 1600. Ieyasu’s army is camped on the road north to Aizu when a rider comes in from the west.
The Western army has besieged Fushimi Castle. Its keeper, Torii Mototada, holds out for days to buy Ieyasu time. Then the castle falls.
“My army marches west with Lord Ieyasu.” At Oyama, the allied lords decide to turn back and fight.
Fushimi falls. The West gathers from Osaka toward Ōgaki. Your army turns back down the Tōkaidō to Kiyosu. Between them stands Gifu, the gate into Mino.

ch4.title: Chapter 4 · Roads to Mino
ch4.task: Choose your council policy, then make the final preparations: fieldworks, granaries, scouts and Kobayakawa.

beats.caption: Your vanguard storms Gifu. The road into Mino lies open.
Gifu still flies Western banners. Your army must enter Mino by a narrower road, and Gifu’s garrison will join Ishida.
Rain falls on the Mino plain. Across the valley, the Western army’s fires burn as far as you can see.
On Matsuo hill, Kobayakawa Hideaki waits. Both sides have sent him letters.
Both armies converge on Sekigahara. On Matsuo hill above the valley, Kobayakawa has still not declared.

dawn.title: Sekigahara · Dawn
dawn.task: Deploy your three formations on the green starting squares, choose a tactical plan, then begin the battle.

beats.caption: Sekigahara, dawn. Fog hides the valley. Somewhere in it, the Western army is waiting.
“Hold until the fog lifts. Then we will see who keeps his word.”
“The heir’s banner flies over this field. Let no lord forget it.”
The fog lifts. The first volleys crack across the valley.

koba_east.title: Kobayakawa’s choice
koba_east.task: Read the coalition dispatch, then continue the battle.

beats.caption: Kobayakawa watches the battle and does not move.
Then his banners move. His army pours down Matsuo hill into the Western flank.

koba_west.title: Kobayakawa’s choice
koba_west.task: Read the coalition dispatch, then continue the battle. Guard your camp.

beats.caption: Kobayakawa watches the battle and does not move.
Ishida’s letters have won. Kobayakawa’s army pours down the hill against you.

koba_hold.title: Kobayakawa’s choice
koba_hold.task: Read the coalition dispatch, then continue the battle.

beats.caption: Messengers from both sides ride up Matsuo hill. Kobayakawa sends them all away. His army will not move today.

west.title: The Western council
west.task: Read the dispatch, then review the chapter.

beats.caption: At Ōgaki, Ishida’s council plans its next move.
